rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Annual Increase Limits
rules.quote: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF). Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.summary: Landlords may increase rent once every 12 months by the allowable percentage, and as of February 2, 2026, cannot add an additional percentage for utilities.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
rules.exemption_note: Condominiums and townhomes: Rent amount is not regulated for tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Temporary Rent Increase Prohibition
rules.quote: Effective March 30, 2020, through January 31, 2024, rent increases are prohibited for rental units subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.summary: Rent increases were prohibited for RSO units from March 30, 2020 through January 31, 2024.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Effective March 30, 2020, through January 31, 2024, rent increases are prohibited
rules.effective_until_evidence: Effective March 30, 2020, through January 31, 2024, rent increases are prohibited
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Legal Reasons for Eviction
rules.quote: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant per Los Angeles Municipal Code 151.09.C.9 & 165.05.B.5.
rules.summary: Eviction notices for RSO units must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service on the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - No-Fault Eviction Relocation Assistance
rules.quote: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance. Checklist for No-Fault Evictions: File a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict filed with the LAHD. Give the tenant a 30-day and 60-day written notice (some evictions require 120-day notice or up to a 1-year extension). Payment of tenant relocation assistance.
rules.summary: No-fault evictions under the RSO require landlords to pay relocation assistance to tenants and file a declaration of intent to evict with LAHD.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance - Interest Payments on Security Deposits
rules.summary: The RSO requires interest payments on security deposits for covered rental units.
rules.coverage_text: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
